# glinet_wireguard_peer (Resource)

Manage one WireGuard peer section on a managed interface. Preshared keys are write-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_wireguard_peer" "peer" {
  section          = "peer1"
  interface        = "wg0"
  public_key       = var.wireguard_peer_public_key
  allowed_ips      = ["10.8.0.2/32"]
  endpoint_host    = "vpn.example"
  endpoint_port    = 51820
  preshared_key_wo = var.wireguard_preshared_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) WireGuard interface name, such as `wg0`.
- `public_key` (String) Peer public key.
- `section` (String) UCI wireguard peer section name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) Allowed IP CIDRs.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `description` (String) Peer description.
- `endpoint_host` (String) Peer endpoint host.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Peer endpoint port; zero leaves it unset.
- `persistent_keepalive` (Number) Persistent keepalive seconds.
- `preshared_key_version` (Number) Client-managed key generation. Increase it when rotating `preshared_key_wo`.
- `preshared_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only WireGuard preshared key.
- `route_allowed_ips` (Boolean) Install routes for allowed IPs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
